episodes.title: Who does the housework?
episodes.description: Unloading the dishwasher, mopping the floor, cleaning the loo... what is your most hated household chore? We all know there are jobs around the house which have to be done regularly, even if they are sometimes boring or unpleasant. But who tends to do the most amount of jobs in your household? And is there anyone who isn't pulling their weight...? Pippa and Neil discuss this and teach you some new vocabulary. Learn English from authentic BBC programme clips. Get a free worksheet, quiz and transcript for this episode: https://www.bbc.co.uk/learningenglish/english/features/6...
episodes.descZh: 卸下洗碗机、拖地、打扫厕所……你最讨厌的家务是什么？我们都知道家里有些工作必须定期完成，即使它们有时很无聊或不愉快。但谁往往在您的家庭中做最多的工作呢？有没有人不尽自己的职责……？皮帕和尼尔讨论这个问题并教你一些新词汇。从真实的BBC节目剪辑中学习英语。获取本期节目的免费工作表、测验和成绩单：https://www.bbc.co.uk/learningenglish/english/features/6.

episodes.title: How I’m helping thousands rebuild their lives after prison | Susan Burton
episodes.description: Each year, around two million women are released from prisons and jails in the US, many with nowhere to go. Susan Burton knows this firsthand: after cycling in and out of prison for years, she finally found a safe place to land ... and made it her mission to offer others the same. She shares how she's helping thousands rebuild their lives — and changing the way we think about second chances. Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.
episodes.titleZh: 我如何帮助数千人出狱后重建生活|苏珊·伯顿
episodes.descZh: 每年，美国约有200万妇女从监狱和监狱获释，其中许多人无处可去。苏珊·伯顿（Susan Burton）亲身了解这一点：多年来骑自行车进出监狱，她终于找到了一个安全的着陆地点……并将为其他人提供同样的服务作为她的使命。她分享了她如何帮助数千人重建生活，并改变我们对第二次机会的看法。由Acast主持。更多信息请访问acast.com/privacy。

episodes.title: The English We Speak: Say less
episodes.description: This modern expression is a way of responding enthusiastically to a suggestion. It means something similar to ‘say no more’. Learn when and how to use it with Georgie and Feifei. As always, find a free transcript here: ✔️ https://www.bbc.co.uk/learningenglish/english/features/the-english-we-speak_2026/ep-260817 For more great language tips and programmes visit bbclearningenglish.com We send a newsletter with our weekly highlights - subscribe here: ✔️ https://www.bbc.co.uk/learningenglish/newsletters
episodes.descZh: 这种现代表达是对建议热情回应的一种方式。它的意思类似于“别再说了”。了解何时以及如何与乔吉和菲菲一起使用它。与往常一样，请在此处找到免费的成绩单：https://www.bbc.co.uk/learningenglish/english/features/the-english-we-speak_2026/ep-260817有关更多精彩的语言技巧和节目，请访问bbclearningenglish.com我们发送包含每周亮点的时事通讯-在此处订阅：https://www.bbc.co.uk/learningenglish/newsletters️️

episodes.title: Episode 1000! 🎉
episodes.description: Here it is, finally! The long-awaited episode 1000. It has taken me weeks to finish this. If you listen, you will understand why it has taken so long! This is a celebration of this podcast after 17 years and 1000 episodes. It includes a lot of rambling, an interview with my brother, questions from friends and family, and the voices of various guests who have been on this podcast over the last few years. Also, regular interruptions from my daughter and all sorts of other random moments such as the sounds of dogs, woodpeckers, neighbours, and more! Thank you to all the...

episodes.title: Chatterbox #352 – Hot hot summer
episodes.description: What does a heat wave actually do to your day? Andrew and Anna compare their summers from opposite sides of the world. Anna is in Madrid, where a hot day reaches 40 degrees and the blinds stay closed until evening. Andrew is in Seoul, where the rainy season just ended but the humidity stayed. They talk about air conditioning, lost sleep, cold showers, and the wildfires that burned west of Madrid this summer. Keep an ear out for these phrases during the episode: Not so fast Respite Bar none To do one’s business Bone dry To bu...
episodes.descZh: 热浪实际上对你的一天有什么影响？安德鲁和安娜从世界两端比较了他们的夏天。安娜在马德里，炎热的天气达到40度，百叶窗一直关闭到晚上。安德鲁在首尔，那里的雨季刚刚结束，但湿度仍然存在。他们谈论空调、睡眠不足、冷水淋浴以及今年夏天在马德里西部燃烧的野火。在剧集中留意这些短语：别那么快恢复酒吧没有做自己的事骨头干为了.

episodes.title: How to Be A Better Partner
episodes.description: When we look at the people we love, how clearly do we really see them? This week, we talk with psychologist Edward LeMay about how our fears, desires, and insecurities can shape our perceptions of our partners — sometimes creating the very reality we expect. He explains how we can learn to see our partners in ways that create greater trust and connection. Then, Sonja Lyubomirsky answers your questions about the gap between being loved and feeling loved, in our latest installment of "Your Questions Answered." If you enjoy listening to Hidden Brain, we think you'll enjoy watching it...

episodes.descZh: 当我们看着我们所爱的人时，我们真正看到他们的清晰度有多高？本周，我们与心理学家爱德华·勒梅（Edward LeMay）谈论我们的恐惧、欲望和不安全感如何塑造我们对伴侣的看法--有时会创造我们所期望的现实。他解释了我们如何学会以建立更大信任和联系的方式看待我们的合作伙伴。然后，索尼娅·柳博米尔斯基（Sonja Lyubomirsky）在我们最新一期的《你的疑问》中回答了您关于被爱和感觉被爱之间差距的问题。“如果你喜欢听《隐藏的大脑》，我们认为你会喜欢看它..

episodes.title: Nigel and the Real Gannet
episodes.description: In 2016, Chris Bell, a ranger with New Zealand’s Department of Conservation, was the sole human inhabitant of a small island off the west coast of the country, called Mana Island. He was there to take care of the island’s fragile and recovering ecosystem, including a colony of Australasian Gannets at the top of a high cliff overlooking the sea. But there was one catch. All but one of these striking seabirds were fake, made of concrete and paint. This week on Radiolab, producer Annie McEwen tells us a love story about a rogue bird and what...
episodes.descZh: 2016年，新西兰保护部护林员克里斯·贝尔（Chris Bell）是该国西海岸一个名为马纳岛的小岛上唯一的人类居民。他在那里是为了照顾岛上脆弱且正在恢复的生态系统，包括位于俯瞰大海的高悬崖顶部的澳大利亚山毛榉群落。但有一个问题。这些引人注目的海鸟中，除了一只之外，其余都是假的，由混凝土和油漆制成。本周，制片人安妮·麦克尤恩（Annie McEwen）在Radiolab上向我们讲述了一个关于一只流氓鸟的爱情故事，以及……

episodes.title: Bobbie: Laura Modi. How a Baby Formula Startup Took Market Share From Two Industry Giants
episodes.description: Laura Modi set out to build a better infant formula. What followed was years of setbacks: a crippling dispute with the FDA, a frustrating search for a manufacturer, and the constant fear that the company would run out of money before it reached customers. But today, Bobbie generates over $100 million a year and has captured nearly 4% of the U.S. infant formula market by challenging one of the most protected industries in America. In this conversation, Laura explains how she made it through—and why many of the moments that looked like disasters ul...
episodes.titleZh: 鲍比：劳拉·莫迪。婴儿配方奶粉初创公司如何从两家行业巨头手中夺取市场份额
episodes.descZh: 劳拉·莫迪（Laura Modi）着手打造更好的婴儿配方奶粉。随之而来的是多年的挫折：与FDA的严重纠纷、令人沮丧的制造商寻找，以及一直担心公司在到达客户之前就会耗尽资金。但如今，博比每年的收入超过1亿美元，并通过挑战美国最受保护的行业之一占领了美国婴儿配方奶粉市场近4%的份额。在这次谈话中，劳拉解释了她是如何度过难关的，以及为什么许多看起来像灾难的时刻……

episodes.title: El Niño Is Back. And Worse Than Ever.
episodes.description: The global chaos agent known as El Niño is back, and this year it’s already on track to be, by far, the strongest and most severe on record, wreaking havoc on weather across the world. Today, Chico Harlan, the global climate reporter for The New York Times, goes over El Niño’s history, its inner workings and its increasingly destructive fallout. Guest: Chico Harlan, the global climate correspondent for The New York Times. Background reading: El Niño, the Pacific climate shift that comes around once or twice a decade...
episodes.titleZh: 厄尔尼诺现象卷土重来。而且比以往任何时候都更糟糕。
episodes.descZh: 被称为厄尔尼诺现象的全球混乱因素又回来了，今年它已经有望成为有记录以来最强、最严重的一次，对世界各地的天气造成严重破坏。今天，《纽约时报》全球气候记者奇科·哈伦回顾了厄尔尼诺现象的历史、其内部运作及其日益破坏性的后果。嘉宾：Chico Harlan，《纽约时报》全球气候记者。背景阅读：厄尔尼诺现象，每十年出现一两次的太平洋气候变化..
